nodes.description: Public address state variable holding the base asset address, initialized in the constructor.
Public address state variable storing the deployer; trusted reference for the onlyDeployer access check.
iDAO state variable used to resolve the router address; settable only by the deployer.
Constant-like state variable equal to 10**18 used for fixed point scaling in unit math.
Caller-controlled address used in the access check, the constructor and token detail helpers.
Miner-influenced timestamp read through now in getPoolAge.
Payable constructor setting BASE and DEPLOYER from msg.sender.
Deployer-only setter that assigns the DAO interface address.
Views token metadata for the caller by delegating to getTokenDetailsWithMember.
Builds a TokenDetails struct, performing external calls to iERC20 and reading msg.sender.balance for ETH.
Resolves a pool address by calling DAO.ROUTER().getPool(token).
Computes pool age in days using the current block timestamp.
Computes pool ROI from staked/current base and token amounts.
Annualises ROI using pool age; combines getPoolROI and getPoolAge.
Computes value in base as amount*baseAmt/tokenAmt using external pool reads.
Computes value in token as amount*tokenAmt/baseAmt using external pool reads.
Basis point helper that validates bp and delegates to calcShare.
Computes amount*part/total share using SafeMath.
Constant-product style swap output (x*X*Y)/(x+X)^2 using SafeMath.
Computes stake units from liquidity inputs, scaling by slip adjustment and one.
Computes the slip adjustment factor using absolute difference and the one constant.
Asymmetric share formula using cubed totals and SafeMath operations.
Reads member pool units and delegates to getPoolShare.
Converts units into base/token share via calcShare and pool reads.
Checks whether an address holds pool units.
Iterates the router token list to build an address array; loops over untrusted count.
Iterates the router token list and resolves pools into an address array.
Raw addition uint c = a + b guarded only by assert; potential unchecked overflow site.
require(msg.sender == DEPLOYER) access control gate applied by the onlyDeployer modifier.
Direct use of now (block.timestamp) in the pool age calculation, miner-influenceable.
token address parameter of getTokenDetailsWithMember.
member address parameter of getTokenDetailsWithMember.
amount parameter of calcValueInBaseWithPool.
bp basis point parameter of calcPart, bounds-checked 0 < bp <= 10000.
total parameter of calcPart forwarded to calcShare.
x parameter of calcSwapOutput.
X (reserve) parameter of calcSwapOutput.
Y (reserve) parameter of calcSwapOutput.
Intermediate _units local variable in calcStakeUnits.
numerator local in calcSwapOutput.
denominator local in calcSwapOutput.
result address array local in tokensInRange.
genesis local timestamp in getPoolAge.
start index parameter of tokensInRange.
count parameter of tokensInRange, clamped against tokenCount().

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against DEPLOYER inside the onlyDeployer check.
DEPLOYER state variable is the trusted reference used by the access check.
onlyDeployer modifier gates execution of setGenesisDao.
constructor writes msg.sender into DEPLOYER.
getTokenDetails forwards msg.sender as the member argument.
getTokenDetails delegates to getTokenDetailsWithMember.
msg.sender.balance is read when token is address(0) in getTokenDetailsWithMember.
block.timestamp (now) is consumed by the current-time usage in getPoolAge.
getPoolAge branches and computes on the now timestamp value.
token parameter drives the iERC20 external calls in getTokenDetailsWithMember.
member parameter is used in balanceOf for the token balance.
amount parameter participates in the value-in-base multiplication.
bp parameter is validated by the require in calcPart.
total parameter is passed through to calcShare from calcPart.
calcPart calls calcShare internally.
x parameter used in the numerator and denominator of calcSwapOutput.
X parameter used in the constant-product computation.
Y parameter used in the constant-product computation.
numerator local is derived from the parameters in calcSwapOutput.
denominator local is derived from the parameters in calcSwapOutput.
calcSwapOutput depends on SafeMath multiply/add including the unchecked add pattern.
_units local is computed and scaled by one in calcStakeUnits.
calcStakeUnits calls getSlipAdustment.
calcStakeUnits performs chained SafeMath mul/add/div operations.
result array local is filled and returned by tokensInRange.
start parameter bounds the iteration range in tokensInRange.
count parameter determines allocation size and loop bound in tokensInRange.
genesis local is subtracted from now in getPoolAge.
getPoolAPY calls getPoolROI.
getPoolAPY calls getPoolAge.
getMemberShare calls getPoolShare.
DAO state variable is used to resolve DAO.ROUTER() inside getPool.
one constant scales the stake units in calcStakeUnits.
one constant is used in the slip adjustment scaling.
poolsInRange mirrors the bounded iteration pattern of tokensInRange.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter is only meaningful within getTokenDetailsWithMember and should be folded into that core function node.
member parameter has no standalone semantics beyond the enclosing function.
amount is directly consumed by the enclosing pricing function.
bp is validated and consumed only by calcPart.
total is forwarded to calcShare solely from calcPart.
x is the primary input of the swap output formula.
X reserve parameter belongs to the swap output formula.
Y reserve parameter belongs to the swap output formula.
Temporary _units local only exists during calcStakeUnits execution.
Intermediate numerator local is scoped to calcSwapOutput.
Intermediate denominator local is scoped to calcSwapOutput.
result array local is created and returned only by tokensInRange.
genesis local is read only inside getPoolAge.
start index is used only by tokensInRange.
count is clamped and used only by tokensInRange.
